description: Evidence an assessor asks for, by AI RMF question topic (topics are defined in question_categories.json). build_ai_questions.py copies the matching line into each entry as evidence_prompt; the assessor sharpens it per subcategory.

by_topic.governance: AI policy or standard, AI inventory or register with owners and approvals, role descriptions, risk register entries, impact assessments, vendor contracts or DPAs, model cards or release records, minutes of review decisions.
by_topic.data_model: Data classification rules for AI inputs, data-flow diagram showing what reaches the model and retrieval stores, retention and training opt-out settings, access list for model artifacts, weights and prompts, provenance records.
by_topic.infra: Hosting inventory (endpoint, enterprise, SaaS), shared-responsibility notes, network and secrets configuration for model hosts, environment separation, provider assurance reports.
by_topic.reliability: Test and evaluation reports, guardrail or filter configuration, monitoring dashboards and alert thresholds, incident tickets and post-incident reviews, rollback or suspension procedure and its last exercise.
by_topic.ai_access: List of AI tools, agents and MCP servers with the identity each uses, permission scopes, human-approval rules for write or irreversible actions, tool and server vetting records, audit logs of AI actions.

default: Policy document, register or log extract, or a named process owner who can describe the practice.
